name: Urahoro (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Urahoro town emblem in white: an outlined four-pointed star enclosing the character 浦.
history: Municipal flag of Urahoro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 5 June 1949.

features.role: Urahoro town emblem — an outlined four-pointed star enclosing the character 浦
